entry.title: Trust Issue While Implementing LDAP Authentication in SAP Cloud Connector
entry.content:
Dear Experts, 

I have a requirement to implement the LDAP Authentication method in SAP Cloud Connector to replace traditional file based authentication which we normally use to login with Administrator user.

Now I got in touch with our Active Directory Server Admin Team who has access to the host. He help us configuring the parameters for LDAP configuration like, Host, Alternate Host, Search Rules and with the Roles part.

However after that when I tried to test I got the error as below.

• Connecting to URL ldaps://XXXXXXXXXXX:636
• Exception performing authentication. Retrying... throwing exception javax.naming.CommunicationException: XXXXXXXXXXX:636 [Root exception is javax.net.ssl.SSLException: java.lang.RuntimeException:
Unexpected error: java.security.InvalidAlgorithmParameterException: the trustAnchors parameter must be non-empty]

• Connecting to URL ldaps://XXXXXXXXXXXXXX:636
• Exception performing authentication throwing exception javax.naming.CommunicationException: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX:636 [Root exception is javax.net.ssl.SSLException: java.lang.RuntimeException:
Unexpected error: java.security.InvalidAlgorithmParameterException: the trustAnchors parameter must be non-empty]
• Returning null principal.
• Authentication for user Username failed

After further researching I consulted the Note https://me.sap.com/notes/0003041841
Requested System Certificate, Intermediate Certificate and Root Certificate of the LDAP Server and created a seprate cer file by merging those 3 certificate. Executed the below command to add the certificate to the CACERT file in my SAP JVM Folder 
"keytool -import -storepass changeit -file <certificate used by LDAP server> -keystore cacerts -alias <e.g. LDAP_xyz>";

Still the same error is coming. 
I believe our SAP Cloud Connector is using that same JVM only.


There is another option I seen inside the LDAP Configuration Page which is the LDAP trust store where there is no certificate added. I am not sure if I need to add the same certificate there also.

I verified the JAVA_HOME path defined as G:\sapjvm_8 under User Variables from Environment Variable section and also checked from services.msc the executable path of Cloud Connector is G:\SAP\scc20\SCCHost.exe

Can you please suggest how to fix this?

I have also attached a screenshot of the current LDAP Configuration Screen with Confidential data masked for security purpose.
But do I need to also import the certificate in the LDAP trust store which is highlighted in the Screenshot?

Thanks and Regards
Anurag

entry.title: New to SAC - Do I Need G/L Account Hierarchy Before Building Simple Actual vs Budget Expense Model?
entry.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm new to SAP Analytics Cloud and trying to build a very simple proof-of-concept expense report for a Marketing cost center.

My objective is to create a model/story that shows:

  • Actuals (from S/4HANA)
  • Budget
  • Variance ($ and %)

Current setup:

  • SAC Live Connection to S/4HANA (S4HANAPROD)
  • I can see several standard finance queries, including:
    • 2CCFIPROFLOSSQ2901 (Profit Loss Actuals)
    • 2CCFIPROFCTRQ2701 (Profit Centers Actuals)
  • The model exposes dimensions such as:
    • Company Code
    • Cost Center
    • Fiscal Period
    • Fiscal Year Period
    • Profit Center
  • Measures include amounts in company code currency.

However, when trying to use the Profit Loss query, I receive the error:

 
 
"No value could be determined for variable:  !CDS_F_2CIFICHOFACC"
 

From the model definition, this appears to be related to Chart of Accounts (2CIFICHOFACC).

In S/4HANA Fiori, I checked Manage Global Hierarchies and currently do not see any G/L Account Hierarchies defined.

My questions are:

  1. Do I need to create a G/L Account Hierarchy in S/4HANA before building SAC models/stories based on these finance queries?
  2. Is the error related to a missing G/L hierarchy, or simply a required Chart of Accounts variable that has not been populated?
  3. For a beginner SAC use case (Cost Center Actual vs Budget vs Variance), would you recommend:
    • Using one of these standard CDS/analytical queries?
    • Creating a custom CDS view/query?
    • Importing actuals into a planning model instead?
  4. What is the simplest architecture you would recommend for an Actual vs Budget expense report where actuals refresh automatically from S/4HANA?

Any guidance would be greatly appreciated. I'm trying to understand the proper foundation before building out the model further.

Thank you

entry.title: New to SAC: Best Practice for Actual vs Budget vs Variance Reporting Using S/4HANA Live Data?
entry.content:
Hi SAP Community,

I'm new to SAP Analytics Cloud and trying to build a story, simple Finance proof of concept for a Marketing cost center.

Objective

I would like to create an SAC Story that shows:

  • Actuals
  • Budget
  • Variance $
  • Variance %

for Cost Center (Marketing) by G/L Account and Fiscal Period.

Current Setup

Actuals

I successfully created a Live Model using:

 
Connection: S4HANAPROD
Query: 2CCFITRIALBALQ0001 (Trial Balance)

This model returns actual expenses correctly.

Example G/L Accounts:

 
 
0010/610082 Customer Events
0010/651001 Brand Development
0010/651005 Industry Events
 

Budget

I created a separate SAC Planning Model and loaded a Marketing budget file.

Dimensions:

GL_ACCOUNT
CostCenter
FiscalYearPeriod
Version

Measure:

BudgetAmount
 

Budget data loads successfully and totals reconcile to the source budget.

Linked Models

I linked Actuals Model with Budget Model in the story and SAC accepted the mappings.

 
G/L Account ↔ GL_ACCOUNT
 
Cost Center ↔ CostCenter
 
Fiscal Year Period ↔ FiscalYearPeriod

 

Issue

I can see Actual Amount, BudgetAmount as available measures in the Story.

However: Actual values display correctly but BudgetAmount remains blank.

SAC shows: One of the blending data-source queries returned an empty result.

 

Additional Finding During Troubleshooting

I created a separate Story page using only the Budget model to validate the budget data before blending.

However, when I build a table I do not see individual G/L Accounts. This makes me believe the fact data may not be correctly associated with the GL_ACCOUNT dimension members, even though the dimension members themselves exist. The GL_ACCOUNT dimension is currently modeled as a Generic Dimension. I chose a Generic Dimension because when I changed GL_ACCOUNT to an Account type dimension, the field no longer appeared as an available dimension during the SAC linked-model mapping process. As a result, I was unable to create the relationship: With the Generic Dimension approach, the field is available for linking, but the imported budget data appears shown below.
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Has anyone encountered this behavior when using a Planning Model for Budget and a Live S/4HANA/BW model for Actuals? Is a Generic Dimension the recommended approach for G/L Account linking in this scenario, or is there a better practice for modeling accounts while still allowing linked-model blending?

 

Any guidance, design recommendations, or examples would be greatly appreciated. I'm trying to learn SAC best practices rather than force an architecture that doesn't scale.

Thank you!

entry.title: SAC IFP Business Content - Model import fails - parent folder missing from package
entry.content:
Issue:
When importing the SAP Business Content package "Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA" in SAP Analytics Cloud, the object SAP_FI_IFP_IM_Profitability fails to import with the error "Parent resource does not exist."

Additional Analysis (from import screenshot):

Based on the import summary screenshot, the error is thrown specifically at the model level, not at the story or data action level. This suggests that the package itself does not include the parent folder/model structure — only the content objects that depend on it.

My assumption is that the content package was exported or packaged without including the parent folder and its associated model, which means the import process cannot resolve the dependency at runtime. The missing folder/model is a prerequisite that should have been bundled in the package from the start.

Could you confirm whether the parent folder and model are intentionally excluded from this package version, or if this is an unintended packaging issue?

 

 

 

SAP Analytics Cloud tenant: Trial

Content Package: Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA
Content Version: IFP 1.14.0

entry.title: Has any ran into inconsistency with SAC saving data?
entry.content:
Users across multiple locations are experiencing intermittent SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Excel Add-In failures during forecast planning activities. While users are generally able to log in, refresh data, and initiate "Process Data" actions, forecast changes frequently fail to calculate, update downstream values, save, or persist after publishing. In many cases SAC reports successful processing, yet entered values either remain unchanged, revert to their original values, or disappear upon publish. The issue appears widespread, affects multiple users and locations, and has been reported repeatedly during the monthly forecasting cycle, creating risk to timely forecast submission and reducing confidence in the SAC Excel planning solution.

The SAC Excel Add-In exhibits inconsistent behavior during forecast input and publishing workflows. Users report that Process Data completes successfully, but calculations are not executed, dependent fields are not updated, and published values revert to previous database values. The behavior occurs across multiple branches and users, persists after common remediation steps (Excel restart, workstation reboot, SAC reauthentication, and add-in reinstallation), and may affect only specific templates, profit centers, or business units in some cases. The issue does not present as a complete outage but rather as intermittent transaction-processing failures between the Excel Add-In and SAC backend services.

 

Has anyone else ran into this and if so were you able to resolve this and if so how?

entry.title: Unable to Import/Execute Dynamic Parameter in SAC
entry.content:
I am working on developing an AR Aging Report from the ground up. The report will include sales-related filters such as Product, Sales Organization, Distribution Channel etc. I am using I_ARAgingGridGenLedgerCube and I_GLAccountLineItemCube as the primary and associated data sources, respectively with the intention of importing the resulting data into SAC.

However, I am encountering the following error:

The user doesn't have permission to access the requested resource.
Correlation ID: 6696200273784954a152783886829908

This error appears to point to a specific restriction (400/403 Permission Error) in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition when standard cubes are bundled into a custom view.

Below are the steps I followed in an attempt to work around the error:

  1. I created my first Custom CDS View using the Standard View scenario. I selected the required elements and created a dynamic date placeholder (ZSnapshotDateField) for the P_KeyDate parameter. For P_OverdueInterval 1-6 and P_FutureDueInterval 1-3, I manually entered constant values.
  2. I repeated the above process by creating another Custom CDS View using the Analytical Cube scenario.
  3. I then repeated the process by wrapping the cube using the External API scenario.
  4. I proceeded to configure the Custom Communication Scenarios and Communication Arrangement, and created a connection to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition using the connection profile generated from the process above.
  5. In SAC, under New Query for SAP S/4HANA, I selected Freehand Query and entered the following:

YY1_AGINGANALYSISCUBE4API_CDS;v=0002/YY1_AgingAnalysisCube4API(P_KeyDate=datetime'2026-10-03')/Results

When I follow the same process without the P_KeyDate parameter, the data is successfully imported into SAC using the ‘Build a Query’ option in the New Query for SAP S/4HANA window.

The issue therefore appears to be specifically related to the use of the ‘P_KeyDate’ parameter in the OData request, rather than the underlying Custom CDS View, Analytical Cube, External API configuration or SAC connection itself.

Any guidance or assistance in identifying the cause of this issue or an alternative approach for passing the P_KeyDate parameter through the OData request, would be greatly appreciated. There is no ABAP environment available for custom backend development or modification

SAP Analytics Cloud, connectivity  SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
